_what: THE single definition of the compat-envelope scorecard shape. Producers and guards derive from THIS; nothing restates a column list inline.
_why: Measured at origin/main 2026-08-07: five emitters declared FIVE DISTINCT column
lists and shared none. Even the two 36-column ones were different shapes. That is
the hardcoded-list-of-a-growing-set defect in schema form, and it is silent: the
row gets written, parses fine, and is misread by index later.
The shape is CORE + PER-VARIANT EXTENSIONS. Core order is load-bearing: a variant
appends its extras AFTER the full core, so a reader that knows only the core can
still index every core column correctly in any variant.
_generated_from: derived once from origin/main scorecard headers, then authoritative. check_emitter_schema.py enforces both directions, so this file cannot silently drift from the CSVs nor they from it.

_known_violation.reverie-scorecard.csv: TWO violations of the core-prefix rule, both measured at origin/main 2026-08-07: (1) omits the core column 'stdout_parity'; (2) inserts its extra 'tool_count_parity' at index 14, MID-CORE, rather than after the core. Either alone breaks core-position indexing for this variant. This is also why collect-reverie-compat.rs misaligns when it appends into the 33-column canonical scorecard (its DEFAULT --csv target): the columns disagree in content AND order, not merely in count. Recorded, not blessed. Fixing needs the emitter, currently owned by hermit-w7.

_core_prefix_rule: A variant SHOULD be its core columns in core order, then its extras. That is what lets a reader who knows only the core index every core column correctly in any variant. `core_prefix_safe` records whether each variant actually obeys it; the checker reports a violation rather than silently accepting it.

unimplemented_comparisons._what: Comparisons the strict standard names that NOTHING CURRENTLY PERFORMS. Declared here so a cell cannot appear to satisfy one, and so the gap is a fact in the schema rather than folklore.
_why: Measured at origin/main 2026-08-07 across all 4 scorecards, 2290 rows.
The strict standard is stdout + INFO log + stack + heap. Mapping each to the
column that would carry it: stdout -> stdout_parity (0 of 2278 non-blank),
INFO log -> compared_log_messages (6 of 2290), stack -> stack_hash (6 of 624),
heap -> heap_hash (6 of 624). Before those 6 rows landed, ALL FOUR were zero.
A cell claiming strict was claiming four comparisons of which none were
recorded -- a green against an empty check, not a weak green.
A column blank on every row also cannot be mutation-tested: there is nothing
to plant a wrong value in. And check_cell_comparison.py, which exists to catch
a verdict carrying no reference, reports 0 of 0 verdicts and exits 0 -- it is
vacuous for exactly this reason. A passing guard there means nothing today.

columns_with_no_producer.stdout_parity: 0 of 2278 rows non-blank. This is the STDOUT leg of the strict standard, and it is the one component the 6 full-tier rows did not populate.
columns_with_no_producer.ref_output_hash: 0 of 2290 rows non-blank. Without it a recorded stdout verdict has no reference to re-check.
columns_with_no_producer.parity_comparator: 0 of 2290 rows non-blank. No row states which comparator produced its parity verdict.
columns_with_no_producer.parity_tier: 0 of 2290 rows non-blank. No row states the tier its parity verdict was earned at.

comparisons_with_no_column.exit_code: NOT REPRESENTABLE. The 33-column core has no exit-code column, so a producer would have nowhere to write. Worse than an absent producer: absent capacity.
comparisons_with_no_column.detlog: NOT REPRESENTABLE. No detlog column exists. The nearest recorded signal is compared_log_messages, which counts INFO-log messages, not detlog commits.

unimplemented_comparisons._rule: A column listed in columns_with_no_producer MUST be blank on every row. The moment a real producer exists, remove it from this list IN THE SAME CHANGE that adds the producer -- check_unimplemented_comparisons.py refuses a non-blank value in a declared-unimplemented column, so the declaration cannot rot into a lie in either direction.
